explanation: Breadth-first traverse the reachable graph while mapping original vertices to copies. Recreate every directed adjacency entry through that identity map, preserving cycles and repeated edges without linking the returned graph to original vertices.
spaceComplexity: O(V+E) allocated space, including copied adjacency and allocations made while attempting duplicate map insertions.
